description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 截图插件闲着时，Windows 内存用到 70% 以上也让出内存，只留常用的部分；以前到 80% 就一点都不还，开着大型软件时几百 MB 的图片一直占着（#500）。截图设置等窗口用上了 Win顺 0.52.0 更省内存的界面零件（一个图标从五个对象变成一个，平时看不到的部分要用时才做出来），输入框的光标对齐到整像素（#501）。权限不变。
notes.en: While idle with 70 % or more of the memory in use, the screenshot plugin gives memory back, keeping only its hot pages; from 80 % it used to give nothing back and kept hundreds of MB of pictures while a large program ran (#500). Its windows use the lighter controls of WinShun 0.52.0 (an icon is one object instead of five, parts hardly ever shown made when wanted), and the caret of its text fields sits on a whole pixel (#501). Permissions unchanged.
